{{Quote|My first master always told me to help others, and they'll help you someday.|PD-28, to a group of [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]]|<ref name="BFTS" />}}
An '''individual''' was the master of the [[Pilot droid/Legends|pilot droid]] [[PD-28]], whom he taught to help others as they would someday return the favor. At some point<ref name="BFTS" /> by [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{EwoksDate|mention of [[PD-28]]'s master|[[Battle for the Sunstar]]}}</ref> the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] stole PD from his master. Once the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] had escaped Imperial servitude, he decided that his place was with his master and went looking for him.<ref name="BFTS" />

==Behind the scenes==
PD-28's master was mentioned in "[[Battle for the Sunstar]],"<ref name="BFTS" /> the twentieth episode of the [[Ewoks: Season Two|second season]] of the animated series [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']], which first aired on [[December 6]], [[1986]].<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|27|A Star Wars CELibration|A ''Star Wars'' CELibration}}</ref>
